OPERATOR APPLICATION

Apply to use Veylet

Independent photographers and capture professionals: apply, get assessed, then pay to use the app and system for your own clients. This form starts assessment. It does not create an account, grant app access or promise jobs, leads or earnings.

Goes to yoda@yodalai.xyz. Leave out access codes, identity documents and private client images. First submission may need a one-time email confirmation from FormSubmit.
